subject: Human Body
title: The Four Phases of Healing
description: Learn The Four Phases of Healing in one minute.

hook.text: Cut your finger and your body launches a four-phase repair operation that can take weeks to complete.

buildup.text: Phase 1: hemostasis. Platelets clot the wound in seconds. Phase 2: inflammation. Immune cells flood in to kill bacteria.

discovery.text: Phase 3: proliferation. Fibroblasts lay collagen, blood vessels rebuild, and new skin cells cover the wound.

twist.text: Phase 4: remodeling. Collagen reorganizes for strength over months.

climax.text: Wound healing is a coordinated sequence: stop bleeding, fight infection, rebuild tissue, then strengthen it.

punchline.text: Even a paper cut triggers four repair phases. Your body is thorough.

quiz.question: What is the maximum strength scar tissue can reach compared to normal skin?
options: 100% — scars become identical to original skin
